correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=2 and every proper n-by-n board colouring from n+1 named symbols, the open-neighbourhood witness condition is inequality of row and column palettes; every row/column omits exactly one symbol. For each symbol the omitted-row and omitted-column counts are equal because the proper colour class is a matching, hence all defects form balanced bicliques and their number is exactly sum_s a_s^2. Sum_s a_s=n proves U>=n and equality iff multiplicities are 0/1, yielding a perfect matching of defects. Delete one row and column of cyclic Latin square of order n+1 to attain equality. Direct exhaustive code compares the identity and matching condition for every proper small named-palette array.

originality.rationale: The exact edge/vertex colouring equivalence and chi threshold are established prior art and explicitly excluded from the new claim. Under that equivalence, the newly assessed statement counts and classifies all failures in every proper (n+1)-palette square-rook colouring: U=sum_s a_s^2, a disjoint union of K_{a_s,a_s} defect bicliques, with sharp minimum n and perfect-matching rigidity. No inspected exact or dominating prior statement implies this quantitative classification. Main bibliographic risks are full uninspected 2026 preprint and possible work under AVD or defect-stability aliases.
residual_risks: The full text of the August 2026 initiating preprint was not accessible; abstract-only evidence cannot exclude an unindexed theorem within it.
Classical AVD edge-colouring literature is extensive and may use terminology such as undistinguished pairs or near-optimal edge colourings without the PCF keywords.
A formula equivalent to the sum-of-squares defect census may exist in a separate primary source not retrieved; no proof of global publication uniqueness is claimed.

value.rationale: A natural near-feasibility question one colour below the classical adjacent-vertex-distinguishing threshold has a sharp exact stability answer for all n: every proper colouring has a precise defect count and block structure, and all minimal failures are spread as a perfect matching. This quantifies the obstruction beyond known existence bounds and gives the full structural distribution for each colouring, not an arbitrary finite slice, a textbook normalization or an unsupported marginal gain.
